rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: CANdide
Exhibition name: Goldstar
rows.Origin: Bred by Cants of Colchester (after 1967) (United Kingdom, 1983).
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Mild fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, urn-shaped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, matte, light green foliage.

Height: 30" to 3' (75 to 90cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
